meta.title: Agent Version Lifecycle — the publishable pivot
meta.subtitle: version_status draft→evaluated→published→deprecated, gated by the publishable flag (05 / 01)

states.label: Publishable
states.sublabel: eval PASS, newer than last trigger

states.label: Published
states.sublabel: endpoint pins this snapshot · serving live

states.label: Needs re-eval
states.sublabel: eval FAIL, or a drift trigger fired

transitions.label: drift trigger
transitions.note: live snapshot keeps serving until re-point

cards.title: publishable is the real control
items: version_status moves draft → evaluated → published → deprecated, but the pivot is the boolean publishable flag on the frozen version
publishable is set TRUE only by a PASS eval that is NEWER than the last drift trigger; any trigger clears it back to false
So a version isn't a mutable object — each edit mints a NEW draft version; the old one keeps serving until re-point

cards.title: The gate (enforced at publish AND re-point)
items: assert_publishable() rejects publishing/re-pointing a version whose behavior changed since its last PASS → 409 publish.eval_gate
The live published snapshot is immutable and keeps serving during re-eval — editing an agent changes nothing live
snapshot_hash must fold prompt+params+retrieval_config+kb_index+skills, or a stale PASS would bypass the gate

cards.title: Drift triggers (any → Needs re-eval)
items: model · provider · params · prompt · guardrails · tools · skills · embedding · kb · retrieval_config · capability_substitution
Re-ingesting a BOUND knowledge base raises a stale-index warning + drift trigger even with no config edit
A drift on a PUBLISHED version flips drift_state (watch/regressed) and notifies the owner (16) — it does NOT unpublish the live snapshot
